slides.text: Binary search finds a target in a sorted array by comparing the middle element and discarding half of the remaining range.
Loop invariant: if the target exists, it is contained in the active interval.
Half-open interval pseudocode: while left < right, let middle = left + (right - left) / 2 and update one boundary.
Binary search performs O(log n) comparisons.
Common mistakes: incorrect boundary updates, overflow in midpoint calculation, and off-by-one errors.
